false_positive_patterns.issue_pattern: Missing empty string validation for sfSubject
false_positive_patterns.why_false_positive: explicit check (if (!tx[sfSubject])) validates sfSubject for empty strings

false_positive_patterns.issue_pattern: Missing empty string validation for sfURI
false_positive_patterns.why_false_positive: explicit check (uri && (uri->empty() || (uri->size() > maxCredentialURILength))) validates sfURI for empty strings

false_positive_patterns.issue_pattern: Missing empty string validation for sfCredentialType
false_positive_patterns.why_false_positive: explicit check (credType.empty() || (credType.size() > maxCredentialTypeLength)) validates sfCredentialType for empty strings

false_positive_patterns.issue_pattern: Missing empty string validation for sfSubject
false_positive_patterns.why_false_positive: ctx.view.exists(keylet::account(subject)) validates sfSubject for empty strings

false_positive_patterns.issue_pattern: Missing empty string validation for credential (composite: subject, account, credType)
false_positive_patterns.why_false_positive: ctx.view.exists(keylet::credential(subject, ctx.tx[sfAccount], credType)) validates credential (composite: subject, account, credType) for empty strings

false_positive_patterns.issue_pattern: Missing empty string validation for sfExpiration
false_positive_patterns.why_false_positive: if (closeTime > *optExp) validates sfExpiration for empty strings

test_coverage_notes: Tests for CredentialCreate are likely found in unit/integration test files such as 'test/tx/Credential_test.cpp', 'test/tx/Transactor_test.cpp', or similar. These should cover: missing/invalid sfSubject, oversized/empty sfURI, oversized/empty sfCredentialType, non-existent subject account, duplicate credential, expired credential, and insufficient reserve. Gaps may exist for edge cases like boundary sizes for URI/type, malformed SLE creation, or rare internal errors (tefINTERNAL). No explicit test references are present in this file, so coverage should be verified in the test suite.
